subject: Retention sprint ownership & pen-test evidence — post-call recap
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Huang <claire.huang@cadencebank.com>, Tom Ellis <tellis@cadencebank.com>, Cadence Bank Security Team <security@cadencebank.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 May 2028 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Retention sprint ownership & pen-test evidence — post-call recap

Thanks Claire/Tom — appreciated the call earlier today. Quick recap and concrete next steps so we have owners and dates: 

Summary of pain & goals (as discussed)
- Pain: Cadence needs an auditable retention profile for production audit logs (login, API access, model input metadata) to satisfy bank audit and regulatory holds.
- Goal: Demonstrate controls + provide artifacts (SOC 2 mapping, pen-test attestation, retention matrix) so security & procurement can complete acceptance.

What Redwood will deliver (owner / ETA)
1) SOC 2 scope summary + control mapping to your DDQ questions — owner: Olga Petrov — ETA: 2028-05-25 (attached: SOC2_summary_2024.pdf).
2) Pen-test summary and statement of remediation window — owner: Neha Kapoor — ETA: 2028-05-27 (attached: pen_test_statement_2027.pdf).
3) Retention matrix showing concrete retention thresholds per artifact type, export process, and custody (how to produce audit logs on demand) — owner: Rishi Malhotra — ETA: 2028-05-26 (attached: retention_matrix.xlsx).
4) DPA template pre-filled + DocuSign link to accelerate legal (we can accept your standard SOW amendments) — owner: Olga Petrov — ETA: 2028-05-25 (link below).

Clarifying notes / constraints from our side
- Audit logs: we retain token-level audit traces for 18 months by default; we can produce exports and bucket them in archival storage for longer retention on a per-customer basis (cost + SLA implications).
- For retention beyond 3 years we recommend an archival export approach (we can automate exports monthly).
- Pen-test: we can share the attestation and high-level remediation summary; we do not share raw exploit POC details but can provide redacted evidence for auditors under NDA.

Immediate asks for Cadence (what we need from you)
- Confirm: primary security contact for artifact acceptance (I heard Claire/ security@cadencebank.com).
- Procurement timeline: target legal sign-off date so we prioritize pre-fill of the DPA.
- Any special regulatory holds/ e-discovery windows >3 years? If yes, please call that out.

Next sync: propose a 30-minute follow-up on Thursday, 2028-05-25 to review artifacts and acceptance criteria.

Attachments: SOC2_summary_2024.pdf, retention_matrix.xlsx, pen_test_statement_2027.pdf

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Security Solutions, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

---
Note: If you'd like the audit log export sample in CSV before Thursday, Rishi can push a sanitized example to the Drive link below.

From: Claire Huang <claire.huang@cadencebank.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tellis@cadencebank.com>, Cadence Bank Security Team <security@cadencebank.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 May 2028 18:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Retention sprint ownership & pen-test evidence — post-call recap

Thanks Olga — this is helpful and aligns with our notes. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Retention expectations: regulators expect audit trails for certain payment flows for up to 7 years — we understand that’s outside standard cloud defaults. We are interested in a documented, repeatable archival workflow and a cost estimate for 7y vs 3y.
2) Pen-test evidence: we need the attestation and the list of findings + remediation windows. Redacted PoC is fine for now; auditors will request the attestation.
3) SOC 2 mapping: please map your controls to our DDQ items (we’ll share the DDQ section numbers).

Procurement: Tom — tentative legal milestone target is 2028-06-15. If Redwood can have the DPA pre-filled by 5/25, that materially helps our internal review.

I can confirm security@cadencebank.com is the primary artifact inbox. I’ll share the DDQ snippets in a follow-up email this evening.

Claire Huang
Head of Security, Cadence Bank
claire.huang@cadencebank.com

On Tue, May 23, 2028 at 4:05 PM Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks Claire/Tom — appreciated the call earlier today. Quick recap and concrete next steps so we have owners and dates: 
> ...

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 May 2028 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Retention sprint ownership & pen-test evidence — internal note

Olga / Neha — I’ll take the retention_matrix.xlsx and wire up a reproducible export job (s3 export + lifecycle) and produce the sample sanitized audit log CSV for the Drive link by EOD 5/26.

Couple of internal assumptions I’ll document in the matrix:
- Archive export frequency: monthly (default) with on-demand exports for legal holds.
- Encryption-at-rest + KMS rotation policy noted (we’ll include key rotation docs).
- Cost estimate: incremental S3 storage + retrieval for 7y — I’ll include a short cost table.

If Claire confirms any special fields required for regulator audits (transaction identifiers, on-chain metadata, etc.), I’ll prioritize those columns in the sample.

Rishi
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Huang <claire.huang@cadencebank.com>, Tom Ellis <tellis@cadencebank.com>, Cadence Bank Security Team <security@cadencebank.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Deliverables uploaded + proposed acceptance checklist

Hi Claire/Tom — following up with the artifacts we discussed. Links & checklist below so your reviewers can triage quickly.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cEvidenceFolder (read-only shared with security@cadencebank.com)
DocuSign (pre-filled DPA): https://app.docusign.com/securelink?doc=CAD-2028-42-DPA

Uploaded items (same as attachments):
- SOC2_summary_2024.pdf — control mapping + section references to your DDQ (see Tab 2 in Drive doc).
- pen_test_statement_2027.pdf — attestation, scope, high-level findings and remediation windows.
- retention_matrix.xlsx — per-artifact retention, export mechanics, sample CSV (sanitized) in the matrix.

Proposed acceptance checklist (short):
[ ] SOC2 mapping aligns to DDQ section numbers (Claire to confirm)
[ ] Pen-test attestation and remediation windows acceptable (Security team)
[ ] Retention matrix demonstrates ability to retain/produce audit logs for requested windows (legal & security)
[ ] DPA signature or comments (Procurement)

Next steps: if you’re available we can run a 20-minute walkthrough of the Drive content on Monday 2028-05-29. Otherwise we’ll stand by for checklist responses.

Thanks — Olga

Attachments: SOC2_summary_2024.pdf, retention_matrix.xlsx, pen_test_statement_2027.pdf
